articles.title: Nearly 200 earthquakes recorded in Pacific Ring of Fire in 7 days: Should you be worried?
articles.description: Seismic activity is on the rise around the Pacific Ring of Fire, prompting countries to issue emergency preparedness warnings. Within the last week, close to 200 earthquakes measuring 4.5 or greater have been reported. Authorities are advising households to gather essential supplies in anticipation of potential natural disasters. Although guidance is being updated, no direct correlation has been established between these advisories and recent seismic events.

articles.title: Fact Check: Colombia gym video falsely linked to earthquake in Xizang
articles.description: A video showing people fleeing a shaking building was falsely shared on social media as footage of the magnitude-7.0 earthquake that struck southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region in October. Fact Hunter traced the clip to a gym in Pereira, Colombia, filmed in August, nearly two months before the earthquake even happened.
